verdicts.reason: A opens with the tiny legal line, so the fine print is the first thing you read. The 'WEEKEND ONLY' eyebrow has dropped below the body copy, the 'Shop Sale' button is a tiny pill lost in a big dead gap, and the can is shrunk and jammed into the circle at the far right edge. B reads in a sensible order (product, then headline and copy, then a large dark CTA on the right) and the brand colours survive. Its flaws: 'WEEKEND ONLY' is demoted to a footnote sitting on the same line as the legal text, the legal text is near-illegible, and the can is small, with dead space around it.
